basis: Inherited amino acid metabolic disorder; evidence does not establish common damage to another organ.
Herpes simplex infection producing genital cutaneous and mucocutaneous vesicles and ulcers.
Parasitic cyst disease; hepatic cysts in 80-99% and cholestatic disease in 30-79%. Pulmonary cysts occur in 5-29%, below threshold.
Inherited retinal vascular disease with exudation, retinal folds and potential retinal detachment.
Phosphate deficiency causes defective bone mineralization. Renal phosphate wasting does not by itself establish intrinsic kidney damage across this umbrella.
Mitochondrial metabolic disease with hepatic failure; corpus callosum hypoplasia in 1/1 reported patient supports neurologic involvement, with limited frequency evidence.
Malignant epithelial tumour arising from renal tubules.
Inherited phosphate metabolic disorder defined by periarticular and subcutaneous calcific masses and the related hyperostosis phenotype.
Progressive skeletal muscular dystrophy; right ventricular hypertrophy reported in 30-79%. Restrictive ventilation reflects respiratory muscle weakness, not lung damage.
Nonsyndromic inherited cataract; associated abnormalities remain within the ocular axis.
Pigment deposition localized to the anterior cornea.
Genetic steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome with glomerulosclerosis and possible kidney failure; no immune mechanism established.
Gynecologic stromal neoplasms arising in reproductive organs, which have no axis.
Inherited cone-rod retinal degeneration with macular atrophy and visual impairment.
Clostridium tetani infection causes toxin-mediated dysfunction of inhibitory neurons; muscle spasms reflect neural dysfunction.
Infarction and necrosis of the anteroseptal myocardium.
Adrenal macronodular hyperplasia causing ACTH-independent Cushing syndrome; no additional common direct organ damage established.
Treponemal infection and inflammation of the meninges.
Demyelinating neuropathy; distal muscle atrophy and pes cavus occur in 30-79%. Deafness is variable; a 1/1 report does not establish a population frequency of >=30%.
Clonal marrow disorder with single-lineage dysplasia and ineffective blood cell production; cardiac dysfunction is occasional.
Inherited macular retinal dystrophy within the CDHR1-related retinopathy spectrum.
Persistent embryonic pupillary membrane, with associated corneal and lens abnormalities confined to the eye.
Predisposition to ovarian and breast cancers, both outside the axes; susceptibility alone does not establish organ damage.
Angelman neurodevelopmental syndrome with intellectual disability and seizures; pigmentation and facial features do not establish other organ damage.
Inherited static impairment of ocular motility with ptosis and pupillary abnormalities; no generalized neurologic or muscular disease established.
